title: 第7章  曙光小区苏老实第8章  老翁钓龙图
slug: 从龙象般若功开始创武成圣
content_zh:
曙光小区，位处江夏市区中心地带。
左边是百十层高的市政大楼，右边是本市最繁华的商业街。
前面有守备局数万精兵悍将驻扎，后面是天一武院等各大武院。
生活便利，安全指数高，甚至还是学区房。
这样的小区，哪怕它外墙皮已经脱落，物业管理一塌糊涂，门禁形同虚设，还不人车分流，甚至保安队的大爷们都凑不出一口牙。
那也还是江夏市最贵的小区之一。
能把家人安置在这里。
作为一个男人，苏老实还是很自豪的。
这还不是他最自豪的事。
他最自豪的事，还得是三年前，他儿子被第一高中特招入学时。
那一个夏天，是他有生以来最风光的日子。
一向看不起他的老爹，对他刮目相看。
眼高于顶的大哥，酒桌上的酒杯端的比他膝盖都低。
就连公司里一向看他不惯的上司，都亲自登门送上红包。
可惜，风光的日子，随风而去。
三年过去，他创武天赋万中无一的好儿子，被第一高中教坏了，泯然众人，已经沦落到快要无学可上的地步。
是的，直到现在。
苏老实依旧坚信他儿子是个被埋没的创武天才。
不是他不行，是那第一高中的老师不会教！
于是，为了给儿子再搏一个前程。

他今天又被黑道上的兄弟绑了。
作为一个武具师，他有一份正经工作，被公司严令禁止做私活。
但正经工作来钱多慢啊。
这些年来，为了给儿子挣钱补身体，顺便贴补外甥杨铁牛的练武花销。
苏老实也不老实。
经常配合的被黑道人绑走，在他们的严刑拷打下，勉为其难的为他们打造各类武器。
所以苏青在考场时也没说假话。
他爹的确经常被几十号黑道英雄礼送回家。
今天接的这活有点大。
光是像他这样的武具师，就被绑走了二三十个。
二三十人对着一截魔龙骨发愁许久，才拿出了一个炼制方案交给金主考虑。
而只是这一个还没敲定的方案，作为参与人员的他，就获得了五万块的报酬。
“有这五万块，要不要再去淘金街碰碰运气？
那三万块的武仙真迹，帮儿子进入天一武院不难。
content_en:
Shuguang Community is located in the center of Jiangxia City.
On the left is the 100-story municipal building, and on the right is the city's most prosperous commercial street.
Tens of thousands of elite soldiers from the garrison bureau are stationed in front, and behind are Tianyi Martial Academy and other major martial arts academies.
Life is convenient, safety index is high, and it's even in a school district.
In such a community, even if its outer wall has peeled off, the property management is in a mess, the access control is ineffective, there is no separation of people and vehicles, and even the men in the security team can't even speak a word.
It is also one of the most expensive communities in Jiangxia City.
I can put my family here.
As a man, Su Laoshi is still very proud.
This is not what he is most proud of.
The thing he is most proud of is three years ago, when his son was specially recruited into the First High School.
That summer was the most glorious day in his life.
His father, who had always looked down upon him, looked up to him with admiration.
The eldest brother has eyes higher than his head, and the wine glass on the wine table is lower than his knees.
Even his boss in the company, who had always disliked him, came to his door in person to give him red envelopes.
It's a pity that the beautiful days are gone with the wind.
Three years have passed, and his good son, who is unique in martial arts talent, has been taught badly by No. 1 High School. He has been ignored by everyone and has been reduced to the point where he has almost no education left.
Yes, until now.
Su Laoshi still firmly believed that his son was a buried martial arts genius.
It's not that he can't do it, it's that the teacher at No. 1 High School doesn't know how to teach!
So, in order to give his son another future.
He was kidnapped by his gangster brothers again today.
As an armorer, he has a serious job and is strictly prohibited from doing private work by the company.
But money comes slowly from a serious job.
Over the years, in order to earn money for his son's health, he also supplemented his nephew Yang Tieniu's martial arts training expenses.
Su Lao was not honest either.
He often cooperated and was kidnapped by the underworld. Under their severe torture, he reluctantly forged various weapons for them.
So Su Qing didn't tell any lies in the examination room.
His father was indeed often sent home with dozens of underworld hero gifts.
The job I took on today was a bit big.
Just twenty or thirty weapons masters like him were kidnapped.
Twenty or thirty people worried about a piece of demon dragon bone for a long time before they came up with a refining plan and gave it to the financial owner for consideration.
And for this plan that has not yet been finalized, as a participant, he received a reward of 50,000 yuan.
“With this fifty thousand yuan, do you want to try your luck at the Gold Rush Street again?
With the 30,000 yuan worth of authentic martial arts artifacts, it would not be difficult to help his son enter Tianyi Martial Academy.
